# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::message_list`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

Message list (`layout.message-list`): a scrolling list of messages for a popover inbox, and the
header that goes above it.

Each [`MessageRow`](message_list.md#struct.MessageRow) has a title (one line, elided), an optional age at the right of that line, an
optional body (at most two lines, the second ending in an ellipsis when more remain) and an
optional meta line. A row that is `unread` shows a dot in the attention colour
([`Theme::attention`](../theme.md#method.Theme.attention)) in a slot at its left; a read row keeps
the slot blank and draws at 0.6 alpha. [`Ui::message_list`](../ui.md#method.Ui.message_list) draws the rows in a scroll area of
at most [`MessageListOptions::max_height`](message_list.md#structfield.MessageListOptions.max_height), one tab stop with roving focus (Up, Down, Home and
End; Enter and Space and a click report [`MessageListResponse::clicked`](message_list.md#structfield.MessageListResponse.clicked), a secondary click
reports `context`), and [`height`](message_list.md#fn.height) sizes the list before the popover that holds it. The list
reports a click and never opens anything; the app decides what a row does (a widget never builds
a context menu, D292).

The heights of all rows are measured every frame (a body wraps, so a row's height needs its
shaping, which the text system caches); only the rows in view are drawn and named by text.

### Function `height`

```rust
pub fn height<H: Copy + PartialEq>(
    p: &mut Painter<'_, H>,
    rows: &[MessageRow<'_>],
    width: f32,
    max_height: f32,
) -> f32
```

The height a list of `rows` at `width` uses: the rows' heights added up, at most `max_height`.
An app sizes its popover with it before the popover opens; `0` with no rows.
